::: {.callout-warning .explorer-label appearance="simple" icon="false"}
**The triage has no formal reading; these are estimates only.** The case study is on the [case page](../notebooks/04_body_triage_case_study.ipynb).
:::

For every one of the 20 paired units, the difference body_variant − control is averaged over the selected cells (owner type × place); the estimate is the mean of those 20 per-unit differences with a Student-t 95% CI over the units. With every cell selected (the default) this is the official 12-cell estimate. The computation runs in your browser over a small export of `data/body_triage_lives.parquet`; the build checks that it reproduces the official values to within 1e-9.

```{ojs}
//| label: inputs
import {estimate, selectCells, group, fmt} from "./paired.js"
data = FileAttachment("data/triage.json").json()
measureLabels = new Map([
  ["Time well, days 1-14 (primary)", "time_well"],
  ["Time well, days 8-14", "time_well_d8_14"],
  ["Health, days 8-14", "health_d8_14"],
  ["Deprivation", "deprivation"],
  ["Exhaustion", "exhaustion"],
  ["Episode rate", "episode_rate"],
  ["Meals per day", "meals_per_day"],
  ["Sleep fraction (time steps)", "sleep_frac_ticks"],
  ["Kicks", "kicks"],
  ["Play decisions", "play_decisions"]
])
viewof measure = Inputs.select(measureLabels, {label: "Measure", width: 440})
viewof owners = group(Inputs.checkbox(data.owners, {label: "Owner types", value: data.owners}), "Owner types")
viewof places = group(Inputs.checkbox(data.places, {label: "Places", value: data.places}), "Places")
viewof dropCopy = Inputs.toggle({label: "Count the duplicate cell once (11 distinct cells)", value: false})
```

```{ojs}
//| label: result
copyCell = "inconsistent|at_feeder"
copySelected = owners.includes("inconsistent") && places.includes("at_feeder")
cells = selectCells(data, owners, places, dropCopy ? [copyCell] : [])
r = estimate(data, measure, "V", cells)
hint = copySelected
  ? html`<p class="explorer-hint">Hint: in every life (inconsistent, at_feeder) is identical to (attentive, at_feeder), so the 12 cells hold 11 distinct ones. ${dropCopy ? "The duplicate is left out here." : "Switch on “Count the duplicate cell once” to leave it out, as the official 11-cell estimate does."}</p>`
  : html``
r === null
  ? html`<div class="explorer-result explorer-empty" role="status">${owners.length && places.length ? "The only selected cell is the duplicate (inconsistent, at_feeder), which is left out: select another cell or switch the toggle off." : "Select at least one owner type and one place."}</div>${hint}`
  : html`<div class="explorer-result" role="status" aria-live="polite">
      <p class="explorer-estimate"><span class="explorer-what">body_variant − control, ${measure}</span><br>
      <strong>${fmt(r, 3)}</strong></p>
      <p class="explorer-meta">Mean of ${r.n} per-unit differences over ${r.cells} ${r.cells === 1 ? "cell" : "cells"}; sd ${r.sd.toFixed(3)}; 95% CI with t = ${data.t975.toFixed(4)} (n − 1 = ${r.n - 1}).</p>
    </div>${hint}`
```

```{ojs}
//| label: chart
//| fig-cap: "Each dot is one unit's paired difference body_variant − control, averaged over the selected cells (spread vertically only so the dots do not overlap). The black bar below them is the 95% CI of the mean, the dot on it the estimate; the dashed line is zero."
chart = r === null ? html`` : Plot.plot({
  width,
  height: 220,
  marginLeft: 10,
  marginRight: 16,
  marginBottom: 44,
  ariaLabel: "Per-unit paired differences and the 95% confidence interval",
  ariaDescription: `${r.n} per-unit differences body_variant minus control on ${measure}; estimate ${fmt(r, 3)}.`,
  x: {label: "body_variant − control", tickFormat: "+.3~f", nice: true, labelAnchor: "center", labelOffset: 38, ticks: Math.max(3, Math.floor(width / 110))},
  y: {axis: null, domain: [-0.35, 1]},
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleX([0], {strokeDasharray: "4,3", stroke: "#888"}),
    Plot.dot(r.diffs.map((d, i) => ({d, j: ((i * 0.6180339887) % 1) * 0.9 + 0.08})),
      {x: "d", y: "j", r: 3.5, fill: "#2c7fb8", fillOpacity: 0.6, stroke: null}),
    Plot.ruleY([-0.17], {x1: r.ci_low, x2: r.ci_high, stroke: "black", strokeWidth: 4}),
    Plot.dot([r.mean], {x: d => d, y: -0.17, r: 4, fill: "black"}),
    Plot.text([r.mean], {x: d => d, y: -0.17, dy: 14, text: () => "95% CI", fontSize: 11})
  ]
})
```

With 20 units the interval is wide, and a single cell is 20 lives per arm. The measures are described in the [data dictionary](../data/SCHEMA.md#case-2).
